other_conditions: Bride should have completed 10th standard education
Family should have no other source of income (not an income taxpayer)
Applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan
Scheme is for BPL families belonging to Scheduled Tribe or Minority categories
Beneficiary must be part of Palanhar Yojana
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹31,000 to ₹41,000 (approximately ₹40,000) is provided to eligible families for the marriage of their daughters.
